title: Global factorization by descent
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, J ideal sheaf data, H a coherent module, N a coherent formal module, and δ:N→completion(H) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let U_i be an open cover and H_i coherent modules whose underlying modules equal H restricted to U_i. Suppose γ_i identifies the restriction of completion(H) with completion(H_i) and carries restricted quotient projections to the quotient projections of H_i. Suppose for each i there exist coherent F_i, a_i:F_i→H_i, and β_i:N restricted to U_i ≅ completion(F_i), with δ restricted to U_i followed by γ_i equal to β_i followed by completion(a_i), and with a positive power of J restricted to U_i annihilating kernel(a_i) and cokernel(a_i). Then there exist coherent F, a:F→H, and β:N≅completion(F), with δ=β followed by completion(a). For each i some positive power of the restricted J annihilates the restrictions of the actual global kernel(a) and cokernel(a).

proof.text: Apply the local-descent theorem to obtain F, a, compatible local formal-system isomorphisms epsilon, and local arrow identifications with retained supplied bounds. This is the unresolved algebraic descent portion, without a global formal isomorphism or global kernel/cokernel conclusion.

At each level use the morphism-gluing clause of module-sheaf descent to glue epsilon.hom. Its inverse components agree on intersections because inverse morphisms of equal isomorphisms agree. Glue these inverses by the same clause. The morphism-locality clause proves naturality, compatibility with transition maps, and both inverse identities. Thus the resulting natural transformations form a global formal-system isomorphism b. Lift b to the full subcategory of coherent formal modules.
The local componentwise factorization equation from local descent agrees with the restrictions of b. Apply module-morphism locality at each level to obtain delta = beta.hom followed by completion(a).

For each U_i use the supplied source isomorphism e_i and target equality to form a commuting square of isomorphisms between the restricted a and a_i. PreservesKernel.iso and PreservesCokernel.iso identify the restricted global kernel/cokernel with those of the restricted arrow; kernel.mapIso and cokernel.mapIso identify them with kernel/cokernel(a_i). Ideal-product annihilation is invariant under module isomorphism: multiplication naturality and cancellation of the isomorphism turn zero multiplication on the target into zero multiplication on the source, and the image of the zero map is zero. Transport the retained local bounds with the same positive exponent.

theorem torsionControlled_algebraization_descent_gluing
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H)
    (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤)
    (Hlocal : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (hHlocal : ∀ i, (Hlocal i).obj = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj H.obj)
    (γ : ∀ i, ((completion X J).obj H).obj ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (J.comap (U i).ι) (Hlocal i).obj)
    (hγ : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ),
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) H.obj) ≫ (γ i).hom.app (op n) =
        eqToHom (hHlocal i).symm ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap (U i).ι) (n + 1) (Hlocal i).obj)
    (hlocal : ∀ i, ∃ (F : CoherentModules (U i).toScheme) (a : F ⟶ Hlocal i)
      (β : N.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (J.comap (U i).ι) F.obj),
      Functor.whiskerRight δ.hom (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι) ≫ (γ i).hom =
        β.hom ≫ formalCompletionMap (J.comap (U i).ι) a.hom ∧
      (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (kernel a.hom)) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (cokernel a.hom)))) :
    ∃ (F : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (β : N ≅ (completion X J).obj F),
      δ = β.hom ≫ (completion X J).map a ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj (kernel a.hom))) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj (cokernel a.hom))))
